items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The pianist and bassist were good musicians but the star of the orchestra was the drummer. His name was Roberto Zappulla... ctx.x: Not long after Duke left Rome, Roy Eldridge came for one concert with Benny Goodman. It was a small combo which I did not hear, but I met the drummer whose name was Ed Shaughnessy and we went to the Florida Club to have a drink with he and Roy. They told me that "Toots" Thielemans, the guitar and harmonica player from Belgium was with the group. I knew of "Toots" but had not met him. It was a nice feeling to meet my ole colleague Roy in Rome where we had no idea we would meet when we played together in Teddy…

Most of the refugees were coming from behind the Iron curtain and were artists. One of them whose name I don't remember was doing some booking of artists in different clubs and he landed a contract for Arstella, Fred Palmer and myself to appear as an attraction in a cabaret called Florida Club which was not far from where I was living, so we opened on the 10th of May. The pianist, bass and drummer of the house band accompanied us and we did three times a half hour each night. The pianist and bassist were good…

During the day, Lily and I visited a different place every day and I had a ball filming the ruins and also modern monuments. Arstella did not stay at the same place where we lived. One day, she told me that the had found a place in a family that had a few rooms to rent, and it was possible to cook there. This pleased Lily and I because we were eating in restaurants and starting to get tired of that kind of food every day. The 16th of March, we moved into this apartment on the via Quintino Sella 20.
